public_rationale: The condition required for scoring has not been met in the reviewed record. Anthropic announced a proposed listing on October 26, and Oracle announced a new OpenAI collaboration on October 27. These support continued activity near the cutoff. They do not disprove a forecast conditional on later failure. With no deadline and no triggering failure, the forecast cannot yet be scored.
limitations: Recent operating announcements do not guarantee solvency.
The investment population and economic meaning of waste need clearer boundaries before any eventual scoring.
Survival to the evaluation date does not contradict this conditional forecast.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If OpenAI or Anthropic die, most AI-bubble capex and debt will have been wasted, since without them hyperscaler capex likely produced very little revenue growth.
conditions: if OpenAI or Anthropic or both die

statement.excerpt: This needs repeating. Investors and the general public are being lied to. When you remove OpenAI and Anthropic, Amazon, Google and Microsoft’s capex has likely accounted for very little revenue growth, which means that if either or both of them die, the majority of capital expenditures and debt raised as part of the AI bubble have been a waste.

from_speaker: if either or both of them die
the majority of capital expenditures and debt
as part of the AI bubble
capex has likely accounted for very little revenue growth
our_interpretation: Treat the main proposition as a conditional forecast. Its historical revenue-growth premise requires separate causal evidence and does not establish the forecast.
Read a lab 'dying' as permanent cessation of its business or terminal financial failure that prevents continued compute purchases. An acquisition, temporary outage or ordinary loss does not suffice.
Read 'majority' as more than half of the relevant investment by value.
Read 'waste' as investment failing to produce recoverable economic value, accounting for prior returns, resale and alternative uses.
Do not count debt proceeds and the assets financed with those proceeds twice.
criteria.support_condition: After the defined failure of either lab, evidence shows that more than half of the relevant AI investment has permanently failed to generate recoverable economic value, including after reuse or sale.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the defined failure, sufficiently complete evidence shows that at least half of the relevant investment retains or realizes economic value through other customers, internal uses, sale or prior returns.

evidence.explanation: The proposed listing is evidence of continuing corporate activity near the cutoff, not the terminal failure required by the antecedent. It does not establish future solvency.
An active collaboration with OpenAI immediately before the cutoff weighs against terminal cessation of its business. It is not evidence about returns on hyperscaler investment.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A verified terminal failure of either lab, followed by sufficiently complete evidence of the losses and recoverable value of the defined AI investments, including reuse and prior returns.
